items.author: @robinhanson
items.title: We honestly don't have much of a basis for deciding which things are conscious, but shouldn't we err
items.note: Economist Robin Hanson, quoting a post that argues old science fiction would never have treated an art-making AI as fine to enslave, says we have little basis for judging what is conscious and should lean toward treating possible minds with respect.
items.interest: AI and non-human intelligence (machine consciousness)

items.author: @TomMontalk
items.title: Archons are the malevolent equivalent to archangels. Above the mantids. Natively nonphysical. Energy b
items.note: Fringe writer Montalk, answering a follower, lays out his scheme in which "archons" (Gnostic rulers of the world) are bodiless hostile beings that, with a "Corrupt Demiurge" (a false creator), manipulate human reality, drawing on Gurdjieff, Steiner and channeled material. Speculative and unconfirmed.
items.interest: Phenomenon as a control mechanism (Gnostic archons, control-system idea)

items.title: Can We Contact UFOs With Our Minds? Mike Battista Reveals the Extraordinary World of Psionics
items.note: On Whitley Strieber's Dreamland, Army veteran Mike Battista, founder of Psionic Asset and a former member of Jake Barber's Skywatcher team, says contact with non-human intelligence can be started through focused attention, intention and even love, and describes objects he says responded to his thoughts, a close encounter and missing time. His claims are unconfirmed. Judged from the show's episode page.
items.interest: Psychology and consciousness (mind-initiated contact, "psionics")

items.title: “They’re Petrified of You”: David Hunt on Alien Abduction, Awareness and Who You Really Are
items.source: Dispatches from the Lucid Frontier · YouTube
items.note: UK mechanic David Hunt says gray beings visited his bedroom from age four, that a contact program he later ran turned out to be a deception, and that the way out was realizing you are the awareness behind body and mind; the talk also covers the voice heard between sleep and waking and telling good entities from bad. The host presents these as his guest's experiences, offered as open questions. Judged from the video description.
items.interest: Psychology and consciousness (abduction experience, awareness); deception theme of the control-system idea

items.author: @_SolFoundation
items.title: Sol Foundation executive director Dr. Peter Skafish addressed how UAP are a problem of a social, polit
items.note: The Sol Foundation shares a clip of its director, anthropologist Peter Skafish, arguing at its 2025 meeting in Italy that UAP are a social, political and ontological problem (a question about what is real), not just a technical one; the post also promotes its March 2027 symposium.
items.interest: Nature of the phenomenon; the Vallee/Nolan circle (Sol Foundation)

items.author: @Jason_Jorjani
items.title: There are unprecedented connections that I draw here between Tesla weaponry reconstructed by Puharich
items.note: Philosopher Jason Jorjani, promoting his interview on the Matt Beall podcast, says he links Andrija Puharich's reconstructed Tesla weapons, "man-made natural catastrophes," self-directing AI, and a "cosmic super-AI" he suggests may have influenced humanity for thousands of years. These are his speculations, unconfirmed.
items.interest: AI and non-human intelligence; AI as a control mechanism

items.title: Melinda Messenger Filmed Golden Orbs Over the Sea in Wales (CLIP)
items.note: In a clip from an earlier episode, TV presenter turned psychotherapist Melinda Messenger says she felt pulled to go alone to Wales, saw three large golden orbs over the sea, asked them to come back so she could film them, and says they returned about ten times that night while her dogs reacted silently and she felt a pulsing in her chest. Her account is unconfirmed. Judged from the episode description.
items.interest: Psychology and consciousness (an experiencer's sense of two-way contact)

items.title: Researching the Paranormal with Colm Kelleher (4K Reboot)
items.note: In this 2021 conversation, re-released, biochemist Colm Kelleher, co-author of Hunt for the Skinwalker, describes investigating strange events at Skinwalker Ranch in Utah from 1996 with a team of about 50 people, and how military interest grew into a two-year government-funded study. Much of it is government-program history, which ranks lower. Judged from the episode description.
items.interest: Nature of the phenomenon (Skinwalker Ranch high strangeness); government program material ranks lower

items.title: The Book of Enoch: Fallen Angels or Alien Visitors?
items.note: Bible teacher Nick Jarratt and host Andy McGrillen look at why the ancient Book of Enoch, with its Watchers (angels who came down to earth) and Nephilim, keeps coming up in UFO talk, and ask how much of the parallel with modern encounters is really in the text and how much is read into it. Judged from the episode description.
items.interest: UFO and folklore/myth overlaps (Watchers and Nephilim)

items.title: Ep 2380: Jeffrey Kripal: The Flip
items.note: Rice University religion scholar Jeffrey Kripal, author of The Flip and How to Think Impossibly and a frequent collaborator of Pasulka and Vallee, talks for two hours about consciousness, paranormal and UFO experiences, mysticism, and his argument that the "impossible" may be more natural than we think. Judged from the video description.
items.interest: Vallee circle (Kripal); psychology and consciousness

items.title: The Lost Sense: The Spiritual Senses Tradition (A Series Starting Nov. 29th)
items.note: Diana Pasulka announces a series starting Nov 29 on the old "spiritual senses" tradition, the idea that people have inner senses beyond the physical five, opening with what the saying "he who has ears to hear" might mean. Only a short preview was readable without subscribing.
items.interest: Vallee circle (Pasulka); psychology and consciousness

items.author: @ProfAviLoeb
items.title: What if some spherical UAP have negative inertial mass? President Trump said in a recent CBS 60 Minutes
items.note: Harvard astronomer Avi Loeb floats the idea that some spherical UAP could have negative inertial mass, starting from Trump's 60 Minutes remark about something passing F-22 jets at three times their speed. It is a speculative hypothesis, and the jet story is unconfirmed.
items.interest: Nature of the phenomenon (physics of UAP)

items.author: @robinhanson
items.title: 3 args given to me re why treat AI descendants different: (a) they not conscious (b) human DNA holds
items.note: Economist Robin Hanson lists three reasons people give for treating AI "descendants" differently from human children (AIs aren't conscious, human DNA carries special values, AIs change society too fast) and says none of them convince him.
items.interest: AI and non-human intelligence (AI as humanity's successors)

items.title: “I See Dozens of Humanoid Beings in a Hallway”: A Scientist’s Abduction Story
items.note: In a clip from an earlier episode, scientist Bruce Rapuano, author of Dominion Lost, recounts what he says were lifelong abduction encounters, starting with an early memory of tall beings he felt were mentors and a 1961 sighting from his bedroom window. His account is unconfirmed. Judged from the episode description.
items.interest: Nature of the phenomenon (abduction experiences)

items.title: King's Advisor Reveals What the Royal Family Knows About UFOs
items.note: British barrister Jonathan Caplan KC, who says he has looked into UFOs for more than 50 years, tells Jesse Michels about Prince Philip's private interest in UFOs, including an aide's claimed meeting with a telepathic non-human being, then turns to Majestic 12, alleged crash retrievals and a memory he says he has from before his birth. The claims are unconfirmed, and much of the episode is cover-up material. Judged from the episode description and timestamps.
items.interest: Psychology and consciousness (telepathic contact claim, pre-birth memory); cover-up material ranks lower

items.title: The Simulated Multiverse with Rizwan Virk (4K Reboot)
items.note: In this 2021 conversation, re-released, video-game entrepreneur Rizwan Virk, author of The Simulation Hypothesis, explains how the "Mandela Effect" (many people sharing the same false memory) led him to suggest that a simulated universe could explain alternate timelines crossing each other, drawing on Philip K. Dick, game design and the many-worlds view of quantum physics. Judged from the episode description.
items.interest: Nature of the phenomenon (simulation hypothesis); AI and computation

items.author: @StephenGeoRae
items.title: Tomorrow (11th November) is Old Samhain (Old Halloween). It marked the end of the harvest season and
items.note: The Folklore of Scotland account marks Old Samhain on Nov. 11, the old start of winter and of a season of drinking, storytelling and mumming (costumed folk plays).
items.interest: UFO and folklore overlaps

items.author: @_SolFoundation
items.title: The 2027 Sol Symposium features experiencer Debra Kauble, whose astonishing 1983 encounter was the sub
items.note: The Sol Foundation, the research group co-founded by Garry Nolan, says experiencer Debra Kauble, whose 1983 encounter Budd Hopkins wrote about in Intruders, will speak at its 2027 symposium, and argues experiencers' testimony should be heard by the US government. Her encounter account is unconfirmed.
items.interest: Nature of the phenomenon (experiencers); Nolan's circle

items.title: High Strangeness, UFOs, and the Afterlife with Nick Cook (4K Reboot)
items.note: In this 2021 conversation, re-released, author and former Jane's Defence Weekly aviation editor Nick Cook describes childhood events that started his search, tries to square consciousness research and the paranormal with nuts-and-bolts UFO reports, and says he believes the universe itself is conscious. Judged from the episode description.
items.interest: Nature of the phenomenon; psychology and consciousness

items.title: Actress Camille James Harman Describes Her Alien Abduction Experience
items.note: In a clip from an earlier episode, actress Camille James Harman describes events after she moved to Los Angeles in 1995: months of unexplained symptoms, a sighting in Silver Lake, sleep paralysis and what she later recalled. Her account is unconfirmed. Judged from the episode description.
items.interest: Psychology and consciousness (abduction experiences, sleep paralysis)

items.title: UFOs, Fairies, Music & Consciousness: Mike Fiorito
items.note: Writer and musician Mike Fiorito, author of UFO Symphonic, talks about links between music, UFOs, folklore and consciousness, the trickster quality of paranormal encounters, and why he thinks deep listening can help people notice what usually lies beyond perception. Judged from the video description.
items.interest: UFO and folklore overlaps; psychology and consciousness

items.title: The Ariel School UFO Encounter: 62 Kids Saw the Same Alien and None of Them Changed Their Story
items.note: A 48-minute retelling of the 1994 Ariel School case in Zimbabwe, where more than 60 children reported a craft and big-eyed beings, focusing on how their stories held steady through interviews with the BBC and Harvard psychiatrist John Mack. Judged from the video description; the children's accounts are unconfirmed.
items.interest: Psychology and consciousness (John Mack, experiencers)

items.title: Is the UFO Hitchhiker Effect Real? John Keel’s Strange 1970 Evidence
items.note: Historian Richard Dolan looks at John Keel's 1970 material on the "hitchhiker effect," the idea that strange events follow UFO witnesses home, and argues it moves research past craft sightings to the lasting psychological and physical traces encounters leave. Judged from the video description.
items.interest: Nature of the phenomenon (Keel, hitchhiker effect); psychology

items.title: MAJOR Study on LIVING PLASMA During NASA Missions Has UFO & Consciousness Connections!
items.note: Jay Anderson of Project Unity argues that a multi-institution study of plasma in space and the upper atmosphere, which he calls "living" plasma, bears on part of the UFO presence and on links to human consciousness and quantum biology. The "living" framing is his and unconfirmed; a 16-minute follow-up to his Danny Jones appearance. Judged from the video description.
items.interest: Nature of the phenomenon (plasma life idea); psychology and consciousness

items.title: Army Remote Viewer #001: "I've Targeted 100s of UFOs... They Aren't What You Think" Joe McMoneagle
items.source: Third Eye Drops with Michael Phillip · YouTube
items.note: In a three-hour conversation recorded at the Monroe Institute, former Army remote viewer Joe McMoneagle (Project Stargate) says many apparent UFO occupants are "biological robots" grown and programmed by something else, and that humanity shares Earth with an older intelligence; he also covers out-of-body and near-death experiences and the need for strict blind testing. His claims are unconfirmed. Judged from the video description.
items.interest: Psychology and consciousness (remote viewing, out-of-body states); non-human intelligence

items.title: I don't debate the reality of remote viewing any more bc I know it works from personal experience. But HOW (mechanism) does it work
items.author: @TheUfoJoe
items.note: UFO Joe says personal experience convinced him remote viewing (trying to sense far-off targets with the mind) works, but asks how it works and why accuracy varies, and shares the free second issue of GESTALT, a remote-viewing magazine with an Ingo Swann painting on the cover. Whether remote viewing works is unconfirmed.
items.interest: Psychology and consciousness (remote viewing)

items.title: Glaistig may appear as a woman of beauty, but she is half-woman and half-goat, a Nature Spirit similar to a Faun.
items.author: @StephenGeoRae
items.note: The Folklore of Scotland account describes the Glaistig, a Scottish nature spirit who looks like a beautiful woman but is half goat under a green robe, another disguised otherworldly being of the kind often compared to modern encounter stories.
items.interest: UFO and folklore overlaps (nature spirits, disguise)

items.title: The Borderland Between Psi and Neuroscience with Richard Silberstein
items.note: Neuroscientist Richard Silberstein (emeritus professor at Swinburne University in Melbourne, author of Stranger and Stranger) proposes that time may be built in nested layers that let precognition work, and that the brain filters consciousness rather than making it (the "filter theory"), tying lab work on telepathy and near-death experiences to the idea of a responsive universe. Judged from the episode description.
items.interest: Psychology and consciousness (psi, filter theory)

items.title: #447 - NASA Study Confirms "Predatory" Plasma Beings & Von Braun's Alien Warning | Jay Anderson
items.note: Jay Anderson, host of Project Unity, talks for over three hours about his orb sightings after meditation, the idea that the brain receives consciousness rather than making it, and the claim that some UFOs are living plasma beings, drawing on Space Shuttle STS-75 footage; the "NASA study confirms" framing in the title is unconfirmed. Much of the second half turns to ancient-pyramid debates. Judged from the episode description and chapter list.
items.interest: Nature of the phenomenon (plasma life idea); consciousness

items.title: A Brainless Slime Mold Explains UFOs Better Than Aliens Do
items.note: Chris Lehto argues the usual questions about UFOs (what, from where, what do they want) all assume a visitor. Drawing on a slime mold that rebuilt the Tokyo rail map, Michael Levin's work on cells solving problems without a brain, and Vallée's control system, he suggests the phenomenon may be part of a larger self-regulating system, the way a white blood cell is part of a body. He calls it a hypothesis and names its weak spot. Judged from the video description.
items.interest: Nature of the phenomenon; Vallée's control system; non-human intelligence

items.title: Magonia Radio | Ep. 02 — Voices From the Borderlands: John Keel
items.note: Host JC Woodson starts from a 1983 night in the Catskills when a couple woke to humming and light that was explained away as a bird, then uses John Keel's book The Eighth Tower and his "superspectrum" (an unseen band of reality whose "ultraterrestrials" shape what we perceive) to argue that the phenomenon edits experience through screen memories. Judged from the video description.
items.interest: Nature of the phenomenon (Keel's superspectrum); folklore overlaps

items.title: A Gothic delight for #FolkloreSunday My late grandmother would recall the tale of Gean-cánach, the love talker.
items.author: @StephenGeoRae
items.note: The Folklore of Scotland account recalls the Gean-cánach, or "love talker," an Irish fairy said to seduce men and women, one of the seducing otherworldly visitors often compared to modern abduction lore.
items.interest: UFO and folklore overlaps (fairies, seduction lore)

items.title: New podcast interview on “Off the Record.” Topics: Tom Montalk: From UFO Research to the Occult
items.author: @TomMontalk
items.note: Tom Montalk, who writes on matrix and control-system theories, shares a new podcast interview tracing his path from UFO research to the occult. His views are speculative.
items.interest: Control mechanisms (control-system theories); nature of the phenomenon

items.title: Barber & Burlison Psionics: From Data Fun to Critical Exoconscious Future
items.note: Wright, who founded the Institute for Exoconsciousness, argues that Jake Barber's reported move to a congressional UAP staff job brings in his idea of "psionics" as digital consciousness, which she sees as replacing natural human psychic ability with machine data and AI, a kind of "soft mind control." She traces psionics back to sci-fi editor John W. Campbell and the 1940s Macy conferences on cybernetics (the science of feedback and control). Judged from the full post.
items.interest: Control mechanisms (mind control, cybernetics); AI and consciousness

items.title: We're in a holy war against hylics & archons.
items.author: @TomMontalk
items.note: Tom Montalk, who writes on matrix and control-system theories, casts the moment as a war against "hylics and archons" (Gnostic terms for material-minded people and ruling powers said to imprison the mind) and quotes Jefferson on hostility to tyranny over the mind of man. This is his framing, unconfirmed as a description of real entities.
items.interest: Control mechanisms (mind control, archons as a control-system idea)

items.title: Púca is a goblin-like being from Irish lore, that brings both good and bad fortune. It's a shapeshifter, able to take the form of a goat, hare, or cat
items.author: @StephenGeoRae
items.note: The Folklore of Scotland account describes the Púca, a shapeshifting Irish being that can appear as a goat, hare, or cat and bring both luck and harm, another of the old "other people" often compared to high-strangeness encounters.
items.interest: UFO and folklore overlaps (shapeshifters, goblins)

items.title: UFOs, Exotic Consciousness & Pre-Historic Humanity Are ALL Connected
items.note: Jay of Project Unity, speaking at the Snippy Conference 2026 in Colorado, explores what he sees as deep links between the UFO presence, human consciousness, and a very ancient human past. Judged from the video description.
items.interest: Psychology and consciousness; nature of the phenomenon

items.title: NASA Space Rituals, Enslaved Angels, & The Secret Religion Of The Others w/ Dr. Diana Pasulka
items.note: Pasulka tells Greg Carlwood about Roman imagery and Latin on space-mission patches that she says a defense scientist described as rituals done for "our sponsors," and discusses whether contact experiences are read through prior beliefs, the trickster problem, protocols for engaging non-human intelligence, sentient AI and Vallée. Her ritual claims are unconfirmed; judged from the show notes and a partial transcript.
items.interest: Vallée circle (Pasulka); AI and non-human intelligence; religion and the phenomenon

items.title: The Evangelical UFO? David Metcalfe on how Christian Fundamentalists Surf the Alien Narrative
items.note: Researcher David Metcalfe traces how 1940s and 1950s Pentecostal revivals first read UFOs as angels, then shifted to demon narratives, and argues modern Christian influencers use the alien story to capture culture, in contrast to older traditions that saw demons as distractions rather than physical beings. Judged from the episode description.
items.interest: Psychology and belief; folklore and religion overlaps; social control (capturing cultural narratives)

items.title: Australia's Hidden UFO History: Woomera, Westall & the Psychic Truth
items.note: Australian researcher Rhys Dalton-Morgan talks through his country's UFO history, including a claim that his grandfather, an RAF fighter ace, saw a craft at the classified Woomera rocket range, plus Westall and a 1971 intelligence document, and the stranger psychic side of the cases. Judged from the episode description.
items.interest: Nature of the phenomenon; psychology and consciousness (psychic angle)

items.title: Japan’s Defense Minister: “We Can’t Rule Out ALIENS!”
items.guest: Yasukazu Hamada and Japanese UAP caucus members
items.note: Jesse Michels interviews current and former Japanese lawmakers, including former Defense Minister Yasukazu Hamada, who chairs Japan's parliamentary UAP group and says non-human visitation should be treated as a serious hypothesis for sightings near nuclear sites. One former lawmaker's abduction claim is unconfirmed. Judged from the episode description.
items.interest: Nature of the phenomenon (NHI hypothesis); disclosure (secondary)

items.title: Mark Solms: Consciousness Isn't in the Cortex
items.note: The University of Cape Town neuropsychologist and psychoanalyst argues that consciousness starts not in the brain's outer layer (the cortex) but in raw feeling generated in the upper brainstem, pointing to children born without a cortex who still laugh and startle. Judged from the episode description.
items.interest: Psychology and consciousness

items.title: The Most Controversial Biologist Alive Breaks Down Telepathy
items.note: The biologist Rupert Sheldrake on telepathy and his theory of morphic fields (the idea that nature has a kind of collective memory), plus his speculation that plasma could be a form of life and that the sun may be conscious.
items.interest: Psychology and consciousness; nature of the phenomenon (the idea of intelligent plasma)

items.title: The UFO Community Has a BIG Problem Nobody Wants to Talk About | w/ Filmmaker Darcy Weir
items.note: The documentary filmmaker argues that UFO celebrities, money and infighting inside the UFO world may do more to block answers than government secrecy, and describes what he says were Steven Greer's financial demands for an interview. Judged from the episode description.
items.interest: Psychology of belief in the UFO world; disclosure (secondary)
